neighbours.label: A time-period noun fixed by a date (the 2020 presidential election, the end of the 21st century); undated sentences stay quiet
fire: Voters say the winner of the 2024 presidential election should decide.
Sea levels may rise sharply by the end of the 22nd century.
The treaty shaped Europe at the start of the 19th century.
Polls ahead of the 2016 mayoral election were wrong.
Cities grew quickly in the first half of the 20th century.
The party lost heavily in the 2010 general election.
Prices doubled in the early decades of the 18th century.
Turnout in the 2008 presidential primary set a record.
quiet: Neighbours say the winner of the raffle should decide.
Sea levels may be shown sharply on the map in the hall.
The treaty was kept in a box at the museum.
Polls ahead of the storm were closed.
Cities grew quickly along the river near the coast.
The party ran out of cake in the garden.
Prices doubled in the shops near the station.
Turnout in the gym was low that morning.

notes: ' century' read 1.08 and ' election' 0.33; 'Over time' 0.14. Several other card examples are not covered.
